THIRD-PARTY DATA NOTICES

Standard Music Font Layout (SMuFL), version 1.4

Canonical glyph-name/primary-codepoint and range-membership data, source
fixtures if distributed, and their generated manifest identities are derived
from the Standard Music Font Layout Specification, version 1.4.

Copyright © 2021 the Contributors to the Standard Music Font Layout
Specification, published by the W3C Music Notation Community Group under
the W3C Community Final Specification Agreement (FSA).

Specification and source license:
https://w3c-cg.github.io/smufl/releases/1.4/
https://w3c-cg.github.io/smufl/releases/1.4/preamble/license.html
License statement (verified 14 October 2026):
"SMuFL is free to use, and is licensed under the terms of the W3C Community
Final Specification Agreement (FSA)."
The specification and license URLs above use HTTP redirects to
http://smufl.formats.music/releases/1.4/ and its preamble/license.html page.
Agreement: https://www.w3.org/community/about/agreements/final/
Human-readable summary: https://www.w3.org/community/about/agreements/fsa-deed/

Pinned source commit: 753f551ca6f96bf24ba38aa2d8a317e706238c51
Source components:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c-cg/smufl/753f551ca6f96bf24ba38aa2d8a317e706238c51/metadata/glyphnames.json
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c-cg/smufl/753f551ca6f96bf24ba38aa2d8a317e706238c51/metadata/ranges.json

The derived canonical records retain exact names and primary codepoints.
The derived range records retain exact range identifiers, inclusive bounds,
and enumerated canonical glyph memberships. Records are sorted for the
documented deterministic encoding. Descriptions, alternate encodings,
classes, font metadata, artwork, and font files are not included in these
derived data. These selected relations are not a replacement specification.


MusicXML, version 4.0

Standard sound-identifier data, the sounds.xml source fixture if distributed,
and their generated manifest identities are derived from the MusicXML
Specification, version 4.0.

Copyright © 2004-2021 the Contributors to the MusicXML Specification,
published by the W3C Music Notation Community Group under the W3C Community
Final Specification Agreement (FSA).

Specification and official source listing:
https://www.w3.org/2021/06/musicxml40/
https://www.w3.org/2021/06/musicxml40/listings/sounds.xml/
Agreement: https://www.w3.org/community/about/agreements/final/
Human-readable summary: https://www.w3.org/community/about/agreements/fsa-deed/

Pinned source commit: 799e2defb2ece0ae7bafe08dcbcac25b2c631d53
Source component:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/799e2defb2ece0ae7bafe08dcbcac25b2c631d53/schema/sounds.xml

The derived records are the 894 literal standard IDs from that exact source,
sorted for deterministic encoding. The transform does not fetch or assess
the external DTD and does not certify XML/DTD validity. Nonmembership means
an identifier is not in the MusicXML 4.0 standard list, not that an open
MusicXML instrument-sound string is invalid.


Distribution note

Preserve these upstream specification attributions and notices with the
source fixtures or derived data to which they apply. The software library's
own code license does not replace these source-data terms. Source fixtures
retain their original bytes and embedded notices. Generated manifest
constants and test vectors identify the source specifications and transformations
in the accompanying manifest and this notice. No artwork or font is distributed
by this data selection.
